_why: Paths (dotted, list indexes as numbers) that may differ from the reader goldens, per cell (lanes/<lane>, pulls/<site>/<scenario>, connector/<mode>, names/<site>). Introduced by wave 5 PR A with nothing allowed: each later wave 5 PR names here exactly the paths its named change (S1-S3, P1, D1, K1) moves. Wave 5 PR P (one downloader, jobs/matter/pull.py) names two. P1: the chronology's three downloads (stages/download.py, stages/msg.py, stages/update_base.py) take a file edited since it was listed, as the demand pull already did: a size the listing no longer matches is pulled again unchecked, and two pulls of one new size are the file as it is now (the row gains size_changed; a file that held the job as infra is now read); a re-pull that is the storage service's NoSuchKey document is still refused, so those cells gain only the second fetch. D1: a displayed file name drops a doubled extension (jobs/filing.shown, full_name for a row): the build_units log line (units_orphan_named) and the named-but-excluded name Records Reviewed shows (download_named_excluded). Every key stays byte-equal. Clear this list once it merges.
